This was the 11th year that the [[List of first overall National Football League Draft picks|first overall pick]] was a bonus pick determined by lottery. With the previous ten winners ineligible for the draw, only the [[Chicago Cardinals]] and the [[Green Bay Packers]] had an equal chance of winning.{{cite web|title=Draft History: 1940's
